# Vendored: the Apache Ossie 0.1.1 JSON Schema

`osi-schema.json` is `core-spec/osi-schema.json` of [apache/ossie](https://github.com/apache/ossie)
(formerly Open Semantic Interchange) at tag `osi-0.1.1-rc1` (commit
`faf581054dcf7964d5fe0ceae7d6f415c8ce32a5`), whose `version.txt` and `core-spec/spec.md` say
0.1.1. It is copied unchanged. The tests validate every Ossie document model2data exports against
it (`tests/test_metrics_ossie.py`).

It is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0: see `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` beside it, copied
from the same commit. It is test data only and is not shipped in the model2data package.
